WAF & Firewall Allowlisting Guide

When conducting authorized URL probes, target Cloud WAFs (e.g. Cloudflare, AWS WAF, Akamai, Imperva) or ingress firewalls may rate-limit or block incoming probes unless the application's outbound egress IP is explicitly allowlisted.

Why Allowlisting is Required

  • Prevents false positive WAF security triggers during high-concurrency automated diagnostic scans.
  • Ensures accurate HTTP status, TLS negotiation, and response time metrics without synthetic WAF challenge delays.

Step-by-Step Allowlisting Workflow

  1. Identify the displayed Public IPv4 Address on the left panel.
  2. Navigate to your WAF management console (e.g., Cloudflare Security Rules / AWS WAF IP Sets).
  3. Add an IP Allowlist rule for the observed egress IP with action: ALLOW / PASS.
  4. Ensure User-Agent header WebPulse-Engine/1.0 is permitted.
WebPulse strictly enforces authorized testing policies and does not attempt to defeat or bypass WAF security rules.
